entry.name: hiddenTiles
entry.label: Quick settings tiles the person has removed with "Edit quick settings". Ids: wifi, ethernet, bluetooth, flight, dnd, nightlight, vpn, cast, accessibility.

entry.name: addedTiles
entry.label: Tiles that only fill free slots (cast, accessibility) which the person has added with "Edit quick settings", so they stay even when the grid is full.

entry.name: nightLightScheduleMode
entry.label: The night light schedule (KWin NightColor Mode) to go back to when the tile, which switched night light to always on, is turned off. -1 when the tile has not changed it.
